title: William and Kate in India for 1st overseas trip together since her cancer diagnosis
summary: Prince William and Princess Catherine arrived in India on Monday for a three-day visit, the first overseas trip together since she was diagnosed with cancer in 2024.

image.caption: Prince William and Catherine, Princess of Wales, board a metro train in Mumbai, India, on Monday. (Rafiq Maqbool/The Associated Press)

blocks.text: World·Photos
Prince William and Princess Catherine arrived in India on Monday for a three-day visit, the first overseas trip together since she was diagnosed with cancer in 2024.
3-day trip marks significant return to overseas royal engagements for Princess of Wales
Prince William and Catherine, Princess of Wales, arrived in India on Monday for a three-day visit, their first overseas trip together since she was diagnosed with cancer in 2024.

The U.K. royal couple began their visit in Mumbai and will attend the Earthshot Prize awards ceremony on Tuesday. William, who, like his father, King Charles, has made campaigning on the environment one ⁠of his biggest causes, founded the ⁠Earthshot Prize in 2020 with the aim of finding solutions to climate change. It awards each of the five winners $1.86 million Cdn.

blocks.text: The ceremony, expected to be the biggest since the prize was established, will feature several prominent guests, including Indian cricket great Sachin Tendulkar, actors Alia Bhatt and Rami Malek and British pop group Take That, making its debut performance in India.
"India has made an extraordinary contribution to Earthshot over the past six years and is home to more Earthshot finalists and winners than any other country," William posted on social media.

Shortly after their arrival, the royal couple took part in a game of street cricket in an alley in Ballard Estate, a neighbourhood in Mumbai. Street cricket, a common sight across the city, is an integral part of everyday life in Mumbai.
Kate plays a game of street cricket in Mumbai on Monday. (Indranil Mukherjee/AFP/Getty Images)
Kate plays cricket in Ballard Estate. (Francis Mascarenhas/Reuters)
Kate laughing. (Rafiq Maqbool/The Associated Press)

The couple will also attend events highlighting India's cricket, fashion and film industries before travelling to New Delhi, where they are scheduled to meet with Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Wednesday.
The couple met with Modi on their previous trip to India a decade ago, before William became the heir to the U.K. throne.

The trip marks a significant return to overseas royal engagements for the Princess of Wales, commonly known as Kate, who announced in March 2024 that she was undergoing treatment for cancer following major abdominal surgery.
Kate, 44, disclosed in January 2025 that she was in remission and has gradually resumed her public duties.
William and Kate meet locals in Mumbai on Monday. (Ian Vogler/Getty Images)
Her treatment included preventative chemotherapy and she says the illness still impacts ​her life.

Since her illness, Kate has significantly reduced her official workload, saying ⁠she is taking each day as it ​comes. While her public appearances have gradually increased, she has not joined William on previous foreign trips.
Her only significant overseas visit since 2024 came in May when she travelled alone to Italy for two days as part of her work focusing on early childhood development.

"I was told in hospital that my recovery would not be linear. There will be good days and bad days, that it will take time," she said in an interview published this week in Country Life magazine, for which William was guest editor.
Kate in Mumbai on Monday. (Punit Paranjpe/AFP/Getty Images)
